strategies.name: Crypto Distance Edge
strategies.description: Buys the favored side of a 15-minute crypto over-under cycle when the Chainlink oracle is far enough (in dollars) from the cycle reference AND the Polymarket book prices that side richly enough — a tiered distance($)→cost(¢) table where the cost floor loosens as distance grows. Holds to resolution.
